scope: Granola connection recovery; existing shared personal-assistant setup preserved

environment.database: isolated in-memory SQLite with repository migrations
environment.provider: synthetic injected fetch adapter; no real consent, credentials or note reads
environment.clock: deterministic mock time for deadline scenarios

implemented: Failed status checks leave Checking and show Couldn’t check plus explicit Retry
Failed or empty reading-option discovery offers explicit Retry
Authentication rejection requests a new sign-in instead of retrying rejected access
Late or unmounted responses cannot update a changed lifecycle
No retry replays connect, preview, share or disconnect
Review text, selected destination and sharing receipt are preserved by loading retries
human_recovery.evidence: 6 lifecycle and actual-client transport tests, source review; not rendered browser verification

coverage: exact application/json media type, same origin and method
malformed and unsupported action before service loading
declared, chunked and understated over-limit bodies
maximum reviewed excerpt with CJK, supplementary Unicode and JSON control escapes
stalled and trickled upload with uncooperative cancellation
pre-aborted and interrupted upload
share/disconnect wait for actual durable settlement

provider_deadlines.shared_from: HTTP entry, including elapsed upload and authentication; callback has its own 18-second budget
coverage: ignored fetch abort and late body
ignored stream cancellation and late rejection
JSON headers and body share a deadline
SSE stalled, malformed and complete open streams
notifications discard without waiting for cancellation
paginated discovery shares the workflow budget
clock reversal cannot replenish a budget
provider_deadlines.limit: Does not establish a bound on authentication, SQL, local crypto, queueing or edge request latency; dispatched durable writes are not raced or abandoned

workflow_regression.historical_reproduction: Three individually bounded 8-second requests or four 6-second requests returned HTTP200 at24seconds after the actual client timed out at20seconds, leaving a pending flow or private preview
workflow_regression.callback: One-use callback fails its flow and clears encrypted details; late work cannot replace the prior connection
workflow_regression.precommit: Budget expiry during sealing prevents a new pending flow or private preview

coverage: Expired access without refresh requires sign-in and sends no provider request
Initialize, tool-list and note-read HTTP401 invalidate the exact failed credential once
Repeated reads after invalidation do not contact the provider
Late401 preserves a newer connection, replaced credential or refresh in progress
Concurrent401 causes one version increment
Transient502 retains authorization and permits a subsequent read
Budget expiry before reading or during lease acquisition retains unused refresh credentials
A received rotating token persists through guarded storage even after sealing spends the budget, and the original refresh token is not replayed
authorization_recovery.guard: Authenticated owner, connection ID, exact encrypted credential and refresh lease state

release_and_external_limits.chrome: New Granola controls have not been visually verified; prior session check awaits dismissal of an open Chrome extension UI
release_and_external_limits.native_providers: No native Claude/Grok/Muse OAuth exchange or universal compatibility established
release_and_external_limits.granola: Real consent/callback, provider schema and selected note read remain unverified
release_and_external_limits.operations: No production capacity, distributed rate protection, retention/alerts, independent-owner acceptance or operational recovery claim
